text_block_list.text:
"With the NHK Mile Cup approaching, Agnes 
Tachyon made sure to gather data on the 
other Umamusume here as well."

The Trainer wonders how Agnes Tachyon 
changed her running style. However—

Telling the Trainer they only needed to 
care about today's results, she left the 
waiting room without offering any 
explanation.
